## Problem

<!-- Link the issue or describe the problem this change solves, and why. -->

## Change

<!-- What changed. Keep pull requests small and focused. -->

## Reuse

<!-- What you searched for, what you reused, what you created and why the existing code did not fit. -->

## System review

<!-- Canonical implementation/callers checked; why the change belongs here;
second sources of truth avoided; acceptance criteria the tests might miss.
Code, tests and documentation agreeing does not prove the premise is right.
If this changes a gate and its tests together, inspect for removed/weakened
assertions and challenge the gate with an independent invalid case. A green
suite from the same snapshot cannot establish its own adequacy. -->

## Verification

<!-- Commands, results, relevant software versions and unverified behavior.
No identifying machine/device details. Distinguish retained regression tests
from disposable experiments; do not claim a gate from an unrelated failure. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue or clear problem statement
- [ ] Reuse checked (what was searched, what was reused)
- [ ] Hooks ran locally; format, analysis and tests pass
- [ ] New behavior covered by tests that fail without it
- [ ] Goldens or conformance output reviewed image by image, if changed
- [ ] Public API documented; README, reuse map and decisions updated
- [ ] Dependencies and licenses recorded, if changed
- [ ] Independent local review done before the first push; outcome attached

## Independent review

<!-- Done locally before the first push. Reviewer, outcome (no blocking findings / changes required / verification incomplete), findings and checks run. -->
